organisms.evidence_summary: A Saudi randomized trial in 94 children reported plaque reductions with miswak and fluoride toothpaste groups over approximately three months. A Kuwait 20-person crossover study found an added gingival-bleeding benefit when miswak supplemented toothbrushing. Neither establishes that one isolated molecule explains the mechanical oral-hygiene effect.
organisms.safety_summary: Mechanical abrasion and tissue irritation possible with improper use; product hygiene and preparation matter.

cross_links.note: Both plants contain small bioactive molecules, but oral-care and AChE studies are not evidence of a beneficial combination.

compounds.mechanism_summary: Electrophilic compound associated with miswak root antimicrobial activity in laboratory assays; not established clinical oral benefit alone.
